newsitem.title: USA: Dow opens lower, sheared by profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dow opens lower, sheared by profit-taking.

text.p: The Dow Industrials moved lower at the opening on Thursday, sheared by profit-taking after last night's record close plus weakness in bonds and the dollar.
The Dow industrials fell nine to 6,168 in early trading. The NASDAQ Index was up 0.16 to 1,245.65, while the S&P Index was off about one point at 723.
The long bond was off 15/32 to yield 6.61 percent.
